# zgerc

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Conjugate the second vector in a complex rank-one update. For x = y = 1+i the only matrix entry becomes 2.

## What this example demonstrates

Conjugate the second vector in a complex rank-one update. For x = y = 1+i the only matrix entry becomes 2.
